function.name: NestedQueryBuilder_doBuild
function.description: Builds the nested query based on the provided search context and updates the inner hits context accordingly. It throws an IOException if the nested path is not mapped and ignoreUnmapped is false. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

parentSearchContext.description: The search context of the parent query. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

innerHitsContext.description: The context for inner hits that will be updated by the nested query builder. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
